records.justification: These lines define the skill identity, exact lifecycle vocabulary, and routing boundary tested by the trigger suite and missing-workspace scenario.
These lines encode root-project ownership, accepted local inputs, runtime results, UI ownership, and deployment state that general workflow guidance would not supply.
These lines allocate acceptance and credential authority, enforce the workspace handoff, and preserve durable state on persistence failure.
The procedure table is the lifecycle state machine that routes create, update, inspect, delete, run, and open work into the detailed contracts.
These checks preserve secret custody, canonical route integrity, scoped history, conversation discipline, and controlled local processes.
The routing line loads repository-specific file, lifecycle, UI, conversation, and deployment contracts only when they apply.
